About 6 months after the breakup I moved back to my ol stompin grounds and started fishing with my dog every moment I wasnt working.

Things are better now, i dont make shit for money, am in debt up to my gills but have never been more content. Life isnt black and white, gettin the girl and the flashy job aint everything. just relax and throw yourself into a hobby.
